notes.title: Patch notes v1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Added translation into French. For this we would like to thank Nicolas Chedru

Added support for the Ansel plugin from NVIDIA. Using the keyboard shortcut alt + f2, you can take advanced screenshots with various effects and filters, including pan and stereoscopic. To do this, you just need to have an NVIDIA graphics card with the latest drivers. Some systems are affected by weather on Venus and Mars, which makes this feature unavailable

NPCs will try to get ashore if they are in the water and will not attack from the water

Now waving a torch, you can with some chance scare wild animals that you did not attack

Now in order to activate the bed you need to hold the action button for several seconds

Fixed erroneous tooltips about building destruction instead of picking it up

Now cages for animals can be built on the second floor

Fixed bug with getting old high quality tools from found skeletons

Now you can hide the interface with the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Z

Added the ability to empty flasks with dirty water. To do this, drag it over the edge of the inventory

The sun rises again in the east and sets in the west

Hit sounds added when a player attacks the boss

Some NPCs will viciously growl, grunt, and hiss as they attack

Fixed some animations

The optimization of the NPC navigation system has been carried out. Perhaps this will improve performance on some systems



I'm currently looking for the cause of a bug with a sharp drop in performance among some users, so a few more small patches will be released in the coming days. Unfortunately, I could not repeat this bug, so I will count on your feedback after each patch.

notes.title: CrossWorlds: Escape — release
notes.notes:
Today, after three years of development, we decided to release the game. We would like to thank all those who supported us, played our full of bugs game and helped make it better. 

  Release of the game does not mean that work on the game stops. At the moment, only the first chapter of history has been completed. Its continuation, as well as further development of the game, will be available a little later and will be released as a DLC. Everyone who bought the game during early access, will get this DLС for free. The online game is still in test mode, and is not a high priority for now. 

  We hope for your further support and assistance in creating not just a game, but a place where every traveler will find his home.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.5.0
notes.notes:
Added the ability to fish

For fishing any sufficiently deep pond is suitable. Stand as close to the water as possible, apply bait to the fish-rod and start fishing. The farther you throw the float, the faster the fish will bite. The frequency of biting depends on many different factors - time of day, weather, location, availability of bait. After the fish swallows the bait, try to pull fish out. To do this, pull it towards you (left mouse button) in those moments when it floats in your direction. If you try to pull up the fish when it swims away from you, then the likelihood of breaking the fishing line is high. In addition, the line may break if the fish swim too far or swim over the obstacle. Better fishing rod has greater strength of the fishing line and allows you to pull the fish faster. After the fish is caught, carve it (right click on the fish in the inventory).

At the moment, fishing is not functioning when playing on the cooperative mode

Most of the icons have been replaced

Added a few new dishes

Added the ability to build a overhang

Now items are not created instantly, each item has its own production time.

Now you can add up to 5 items to the production queue. Using the right mouse button, you can cancel the production of the second and subsequent items. During production, movement speed is reduced.

Added the ability to build a saw bench. It produces planks with increased speed and with less wood

Changed the lighting of some generated light sources

Now on the cages with animals there is additional information about the availability of feeders with fodder

Fixed some minor bugs

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.4.0
notes.notes:
The base speed of the animals was slightly increased, but now it decreases when injured.

Changed the algorithm for pathfinding NPC

Now the NPC will be less likely to pretend to be submarines and walk along the bottom of reservoirs.

Now, enemies which decide to escape, return to the battle only after recovering at least 80% of health

Changed the respawn algorithm for some resources and vegetation. Most plants will grow up again next spring. Clay is also restored annually.

Changed plant growth algorithm. Now plant growth occurs daily, with the exception of winter.

Reduced the number of extracted resources with wrong tool. Profile stone/iron tools produce  40/80% more resources than wrong tools.

The flight of the glider is now influenced by the wind, the number of filled cells in the inventory, the time of year, some of the objects you fly over, the time of day. For example, in flight over a reservoir, the lift force is increased during the daytime, and reduced at night.

Added the ability to turn on planar reflections near water bodies. Turn on it only if FPS is not important to you and you want to use the video card as heating equipment.

Fixed bug with splitting stack with pressed shift key

Fixed some descriptions and tooltips for building

Fixed a bug where it was sometimes impossible to attach a wall-mounted torch to the wall

The interface of the journal is adapted to different screen resolutions

Fixed bug with disappearing ferns

Fixed some bugs on the map

The shadows from the moon and the sun will move much more smoothly

Fixed wrong moonlight direction

In the fences of the village there will be fewer holes

Now during building you can see and change the direction of opening the doors


Many other small changes and fixes

notes.title: Patch notes v0.1.1.0
notes.notes:
Added cooperative mode (experimental function). To create a game that is accessible for connection, check the corresponding checkbox at the start of a new game or similar item in the "Co-op mode" menu, and start a new game or continue the old game. After that, your game will be searchable. To join the game, go to "Co-op mode" in the main menu and click the "Search" button.
New default hotkeys:
Tab - Open the list of players, with the ability to kick the player (available only  for server)
Enter - chat


Unfortunately, when the multiplayer was added, the saving format was slightly changed, which resulted in the loss of information about the character on the old saves - his inventory, coordinates, etc. All buildings and their contents are preserved.


Added the ability to create a new game without deleting the previous game

Work has begun on the volcanic biome. Now it is partially closed but it can already be found

The backpack now adds slots to the main inventory, and is not a separate container, as before

Changed some animations

Changed lighting logic in caves, as well as shadows in the world

Changed the appearance of the list of recipes

Recipes of cooking and some items made in individual buildings now are shown in the list of main recipes

Added small changes to the landscape

Fixed a number of old bugs, added new ones

notes.title: Patch notes v0.1.0.0
notes.notes:
The old world is no longer available. Now with each new game the world will be different from the previous one. The number of variations of the worlds will increase with subsequent patches.

The amount of vegetation in the world is significantly increased

Some 3d models have been changed

Changed some character animations

Changed the mechanics of death - now, dying without a statue of resurrection, you will be resurrected at an arbitrary point of the world

Added a crosshair for long-range weapons, changed the speed of the arrows depending on the type of weapon

Partially redesigned graphical component of the game

Improved optimization, resulting in reduced memory usage

In the game settings a new parameter is added, which determines the range of the world loading. Its increase can significantly affect the FPS

Added the ability to crouch. To work correctly, it is recommended to reset the control settings by pressing the default button in the control settings

Also, some changes in the balance were added and fixed several bugs


For testing purposes, temporarily disabled desert biome and vegetation growth

The work on the cooperative mode of the game was completed, but, unfortunately, we did not have time to conduct a full test, so it will be added in about a week

We would be very grateful if you report any bugs. You can do this here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/511430/discussions/0/348293230314458315/

notes.title: Patch notes v 0.0.1.9a

Added possibility to sleep:


To sleep, you will need a tent, a sleeping bag or bed.

The bed can be placed only in the house.

Sleep time is taken into account in the processing of materials in the dryer, the food loses its freshness, respectively.

Sleep restores 30 health and gives a temporary buff to increase stamina regeneration.

During sleep, a little worse your thirst and hunger.

Sleep duration - 8 game hours. Repeated sleep is possible not earlier than after 12 game hours.


Added Steam Trading Cards

The landscape changed a little

The starting point is been moved

Fixed a bug with an empty backpack after loading

Changed the display of distant shadows

Accelerated animation of some actions

notes.title: Patch notes v0.0.1.4
notes.notes:
Duration of disease and debuff reduced to 5 minutes

 Fixed bug with incorrect displaying duration of disease and debuffs

 Added little resistance from the cold to summer clothes

 Added new achievements


 Added ability to select the level of difficulty. At the moment, you can change it in the menu(menu->options->game).In the following patches this feature will be removed and you will be able to choose the level of difficulty only when starting a new game

At the level of difficulty "Normal":

  decreased by 30% effect from diseases, consumption of food and water

  increased the damage by 20%

  10 points are added to the parameters of armor and resistance to cold and heat

  while running is not increased the rate of food waste
